blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A dangerous heat index gripped five areas on Thursday as the El Niño phenomenon continues to affect the country, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). The highest heat index for the day was recorded in Dipolog, Zamboanga del Norte and Puerto Princesa, Palawan which peaked at 43°C, while Coron and Cuyo in Palawan and Butuan City, Agusan del Norte experienced a heat index of 42°C.
